supported_scope: Root-supported finite charge words follow conditionally from polynomial Hall generation, its graded Kac support, and the polynomial operator-map interface.
The moment-block proof uses indecomposability, the trace annihilator, a closed orbit at real level zero, and quaternionic rotation.
The moment lemma guarantees a scalar stabilizer subgroup, not an exactly scalar whole stabilizer.
Complementary monopoles in a rank-one-framing enlargement force at least two weight-zero blocks if a nontrivial generator survives; their direct sum contradicts regular freeness.
The conclusion is equality of actual cocharacter/full-torus ideals, retaining nilpotents and preserving coefficient maps, including resonant regular characters and empty loci.
remaining_gaps: C_POLY_MAPS remains conditional on its full filtered rational degeneration, sign, and polynomial-regularity calculation.
Coefficient-compatible arbitrary-flavor BFN minuscule generation and the ineffective-scalar algebra splitting require independent verification beyond the old cut certificate.
Kac-support passage to characteristic zero, the moment trace-annihilator realization, and the Kempf-Ness/rotation interfaces are source arguments, not independently certified old results.
The retrieved Hall theorem statements support attribution and scope but do not constitute independent replay of their full proofs.
An exactly scalar stabilizer for each moment block would be an unsupported strengthening and is not required for the fixed-ideal argument.
